name: Michael Levin
abstract_title: Diverse intelligence in unconventional embodiments: origins and implications"
abstract: Developmental biology is uniquely poised to contribute to the study of embodied minds, because it is there that we see, right in front of our eyes, the journey from physics and chemistry to behavioral science and beyond.
